_about: How hard monsters hit and how much they can take, by where they are. Kyle, 14 Nov 2026: 'I want Dungeons to NEED a group of 5 and open world should still have danger to it.....not tank and spanking Everything mindlessly.' Tuned with tools/sim_difficulty.py against real creatures and real bosses; read by world/difficulty.py.
_measured: tools/sim_difficulty.py, 14 Nov 2026, geared but untalented characters. BEFORE: one same-level open-world creature cost a solo player about 19% of their health on average (a warrior 4-15%), three at once were often survivable, and a party of three beat every dungeon boss tested with nobody dying. AFTER, open world at 1.35: one creature costs melee 10-30% and casters 30-50%, two at once usually kills a caster and leaves melee low, three at once almost always kills. AFTER, dungeons (boss 3.0/4.4 for older kits, tuned_boss 2.2/3.6 for the hand-tuned isle and hive bosses): a party of five beat all 25 bosses tested in Ragefire, Wailing Caverns, Shadowfang, Razorfen Kraul, the Drowning Floor, the Cistern, Khaz Varun, the Emberdeep and the Royal Hive. A party of three lost to all but a few first bosses (Oggleflint, Roogug, Gatewarden Hrun).
_field_boss: Kyle, 14 Nov 2026, after a pair at level 17 beat Tidelord Gharesh (5,618 health) in the Echo Isles grotto: 'keep Dungeons around 3x health and 3x damage. So harder than [1.5x] but easier than they were [4.4x]. He did it with 2 people. So why the fuck not.' Every boss, dungeon or cave or named rare, is 3x health and 3x damage. 'boss' (the 97 in real dungeons) and 'field_boss' stay separate keys so they can be split again.
_hidden: Kyle, 14 Nov 2026. A hidden level under a dungeon: 'instead of... 3x HP and 3x Damage... it's 4x HP and 4.5x Damage... they drop at 4 to 5 ilvl... Trash gets buffed too.' A hidden open-world map (skull zone): 'Open world will be 2.5x hp and 2.5x damage.' Which creatures are which comes from world/hidden_zones.py; loot_ilvl_bonus lifts their drops (combat/combat_engine.py).
